capabilities: Insert dates and times from natural-language expressions via an @ autosuggest
Replace selected text with a date link using commands
Pick dates visually with a calendar date picker
Open or create daily notes through a URI action
Configure date, time, and periodic-note formats
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Several languages (Chinese, German, Portuguese, Korean, Dutch) are partially supported or in development. Suggestion history is stored in .obsidian/plugins/nldates-revived/history.json. BRAT is required for beta builds. The README says the community should fork it if it becomes unmaintained.
intentEvidence: This is a revived and improved version of the popular "Natural Language Dates" plugin for Obsidian.
motivation: The author revived the original Natural Language Dates plugin to bring it back to life with a modern engine, true multilingual support, and smarter time handling.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type phrases like "next Monday at 3pm" and have them resolved into formatted dates or links.

relations.evidence: This is a revived and improved version of the popular "Natural Language Dates" plugin for Obsidian.
Optional formats for linking to weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly notes (e.g. used by the Periodic Notes plugin)

summary: Date autocomplete that parses natural-language date expressions in multiple languages and inserts dates, times, or wikilinks.
